articles_licensed_ck.name: articles_licensed_ck
articles_licensed_ck.value: "articles"."type" <> 'licensed_copy' or ("articles"."source_item_id" is not null and "articles"."grant_id" is not null and "articles"."is_indexable" = false)

feed_entries_target_ck.name: feed_entries_target_ck
feed_entries_target_ck.value:
("feed_entries"."kind" = 'source_card' and "feed_entries"."source_item_id" is not null and "feed_entries"."source_revision_id" is not null and "feed_entries"."article_id" is null)
       or ("feed_entries"."kind" = 'article' and "feed_entries"."article_id" is not null and "feed_entries"."source_revision_id" is null and "feed_entries"."source_item_id" is null)
